items.title: Pay dental invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag spätestens 30 Tage nach dem Rechnungsdatum auf das unten angegebene Konto.
items.computation: Anchor is the invoice date 04.09.2025 (Rechnungsdatum). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (04.09.2025) is not counted, so counting starts 05.09.2025. Adding 30 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Saturday, 04.10.2025. Since that day is a Saturday, § 193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day, Monday, 06.10.2025.

warnings: The invoice's IBAN (DE11 3705 0198 0003 0303 03) is well-formed and German, but a valid IBAN does not by itself prove it belongs to this dental practice; confirm it matches details you already have on file for this practice before paying.
